name: wf-marketplace
description: Claude Code marketplace hosting the wf core plugin and the wf-caps default-capabilities pack.

plugins.name: wf
plugins.description: wf:* skill chain for ADO-tracked tasks: spec/plan/implement, verify, QA (gen/run/auto/followup), classify, triage, branch/commit/pr. Domain-free core. Stack/domain capabilities ship in the wf-caps plugin.

plugins.name: wf-caps
plugins.description: wf default-capabilities pack: non-core, stack/domain-specific capabilities for the wf workflow. Ships the migration capability (migration-map), the browser-qa capability (qa-engine), the angular stack capability (qa-host + test-page, qa-execution host provider), and the node-ts stack capability (test-node).
